title: 1-Hour Study With Me 🌲🌧️ Forest Rain Pomodoro 50/10 · Deep Focus Timer (Rain Sounds)
description:
One hour of deep focus in a rainy forest. 🌧️ A single Pomodoro cycle — 50 minutes focus + 10 minutes break — with gentle rain sounds to keep you calm and concentrated. No talking, no distractions. Press play, put your phone away and study with me.

⏱️ FORMAT
• 10-second countdown to begin
• 50 minutes focus + 10 minutes break
• Soft countdown in the last 10 seconds of each phase
• Calming forest-rain ambience throughout

🕖 TIMESTAMPS
00:00 — Get ready (10-second countdown)
00:10 — Focus · 50:00
50:10 — Break · 10:00
1:00:10 — Well done 🎉

🎧 Best with headphones. Loop it for a full study session or pair it with our 3-hour version.

🌱 Like & subscribe for more study-with-me timers, rain sounds and deep-focus sessions.
